user.title: Set up Alamos
user.description: Connect aPager PRO / AMweb webhooks and the Alamos availability API. A webhook URL is generated after setup. The API key is optional and only required for answering alarms (accept/reject).

data.name: Name
data.api_key: API key (aPager PRO → Availability → External access)

create_entry.default:
Setup complete.

Webhook URL for new alarms (aPager PRO "General webhooks" / AMweb "new alarm"):
`{webhook_url}`

Webhook URL for recalls / cancelled alarms (e.g. a second aPager PRO webhook which is only sent on a recall):
`{webhook_recall_url}`

Webhook URL for "no alarm open anymore" (AMweb):
`{webhook_clear_url}`

init.title: Alamos options
init.description:
Webhook URL for new alarms:
`{webhook_url}`

Webhook URL for recalls / cancelled alarms:
`{webhook_recall_url}`

Webhook URL for "no alarm open anymore":
`{webhook_clear_url}`{additional_webhooks}

data.api_key: API key (leave empty to disable the API)
data.record_raw_data: Store raw data in the history

data_description.unit_filter: Only process alarms of these units (case-insensitive). Empty = all. Alarms without a unit are always processed.
data_description.favorite_unit: If several units are alerted, this unit is always listed first and used as the main unit (case-insensitive).
data_description.test_keywords: If the keyword contains one of these terms (e.g. "Probealarm"), only the `test_alarm` event is fired; the alarm sensor stays off.
data_description.reset_minutes: Use 0 for AMweb with a "no alarm open anymore" URL.
data_description.webhook_count: Number of webhooks (1–5) with their own alarm count. All 5 webhook URLs above are always active; `?event=recall` and `?event=clear` work with every URL.
data_description.record_raw_data: The attribute `data` contains all received parameters, possibly the address of the incident or personal data. It is always available in the current state; enable this to also store it in the history (recorder).

state.no_alarm: No alarm in the last 3 minutes

send_feedback.name: Send feedback
send_feedback.description: Answers all alarms received within the last 3 minutes via the Alamos API.

config_entry_id.name: Alamos entry
config_entry_id.description: Entry to use. If omitted, all entries with an API key are used.

suppress_notification.name: Suppress notification
suppress_notification.description: Do not send the confirmation push notification to the phone.

reset_alarm.name: Reset alarm
reset_alarm.description: Marks the current alarm as finished.

config_entry_id.name: Alamos entry
config_entry_id.description: Entry to reset. If omitted, all entries are reset.

reset_alarm_count.name: Reset alarm count
reset_alarm_count.description: Resets the alarm count and the webhook counts to 0, or only the count of one webhook.

config_entry_id.name: Alamos entry
config_entry_id.description: Entry to reset. If omitted, all entries are reset.

webhook.name: Webhook
webhook.description: Number of the webhook (1–5) whose count is reset. If omitted, the alarm count and all webhook counts are reset.

invalid_api_key.message: The Alamos API key is invalid (HTTP 403).

no_subscription.message: The smart home subscription or licence is missing (HTTP 409).

api_error.message: Error communicating with the Alamos API: {error}
